source_tests: HumanEval+ (EvalPlus, Liu et al. 2023, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/evalplus/evalplus), HumanEval/68 from https://huggingface.co/datasets/evalplus/humanevalplus
statement: Given a list of non-negative integers, find the smallest even value. Return a list with two elements: that value and the index of its first occurrence. If the list has no even value or is empty, return an empty list.
